notes.title: Update – postponed Early Access release
notes.notes:
Release Update – New Timeline 

Hey everyone,

We’ve made the decision to shift the Early Access and full release of Cult of the Child Eater by about 2–3 months.

This wasn’t an easy call — we know many of you are eager to play — but this extra time will help us deliver the kind of horror experience we’ve always aimed for: one that’s immersive, polished, and fully worth your time.

While we haven’t shared much publicly over the past few months, development has never slowed down for a second. We’ve been working hard behind the scenes, and the current internal version of the game already includes many new features, improvements, and content that go far beyond what’s currently available in the public build.

Here’s what the extra time is helping us focus on:

More puzzles overall — including co-op-friendly designs that are more satisfying and encourage player collaboration

Stronger, more dynamic horror moments that build tension

A plethora of new gameplay features and more extensive progression systems to keep players engaged over time

A more fleshed-out story with expanded lore and richer worldbuilding

Extensive bug fixing and polish to improve visuals, boost performance, and ensure a smoother, more stable gameplay experience



And don’t worry — you won’t be left in the dark while we continue development. Starting now, we’ll be posting more regular updates, behind-the-scenes insights, and progress previews across our channels. If you’ve been curious about what’s going on, you’ll be able to follow it all much more closely.

Thank you for your continued support and patience — it means a lot to us.


— Uncle George Games

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes 06.13
notes.notes:
Demo Patch Notes 06.13 – Patch 1.1.75 * New Stuff 

Improved Voice Chat stability and audio transmission through walls and floors,

If Voice Chat fails to connect, players can still continue the game without it,

Cultists now react to Windows’ default microphone input instead of Voice Chat data,

Refined Whack-A-Monster puzzle responsiveness and improved its sound effects,

Added a pop-up in the lobby when creating a room to highlight the importance on who should be creating the room

,

Bug Fixes 

Fixed the end-game screen's inconsistent characters and XP UI errors when someone left or had a poor connection,

Corrected Cryptex puzzle ring-rotation interaction issues,

Fixed several incorrect puzzle spawn locations,

Ensured Hot’n’Cold puzzle now appears in all intended lavatories, not just one

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes 06.11
notes.notes:
Dear Players!  

Thank you for your feedbacks!

Here is our latest  Demo patch: 

Improved UI/UX both in lobbies and in-game,

Reworked Puzzle Colors to be more distinct for better visibility, and also changed how they are shown on texts,

Players can now close Notes by pressing “E” again,

Added a DLSS option to the graphics settings for NVIDIA GPUs (FSR support coming soon),

Replaced the default channeling start and end sounds with more fitting audio cues,

Updated the first-time in-game tutorial pop-ups to better reflect the game’s current state,

The default “Player” name is now swapped with the Steam User’s Name,

Added the current puzzle's name and an escape button to the Journal-Based Virtual Keyboard,

Added 2 new unique cultists models + voice lines,

Time-consuming puzzles now spawn in less-frequented areas, reducing interruptions by cultists,

Added the brand new “Whack-A-Monster” puzzle as a starter puzzle,

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172560/9b098bac036a33def2e7482cc35f35bf6d5f5eb2.gif"]

Changed the Bear Picture puzzle from a Starter Puzzle to a Joker Puzzle,

Temporarily removed the 2 Distraction items on the wall as they were not serving their purpose properly. We'll update it and bring it back later,

Added sound effects for the Blackjack. It now automatically closes the UI when the player wins, and we fixed the Aspect Ratio of the UI,

 Player Stat Balancing 

Nerfed Fitness,

Buffed Precision, Endurance,

 Bug Fixes 

Prevented items from being used while interacting with the settings UI,

Fixed a bug with the Mastermind Puzzle when it was reopened after leaving it half-done,

Fixed a bug when the player left via the in-game menu, some sounds could get stuck,

Fixed a bug where sometimes the pentagrams on the map that indicate an exit would not disappear properly after finishing the puzzles,

Fixed a bug where Cultists could open locked doors by walking into them,

Fixed incorrect door opening/closing rotations





P.S. : We know, some puzzles are hard!! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Playtest Patch Note
notes.notes:
1.1.43 patch notes:
New Features:

Added unique sound effects for each channeling animation.,
Now there is an automatic puzzle selection when the previous one is solved.,
Added a sound effect and voice line when an Exit door opens.,
Added map indicators to indicate the opening of an Exit door.,
The 5th ping, which puts your pinging on cooldown is now a different color.,

Puzzle Improvements:

Revamped the visual design of the Quiz puzzle.,
Fixed inconsistencies in the new Quiz questions and added brand-new, verified questions.,
Reworked the Picture Sorter puzzle for more dynamic gameplay and resolved related bugs.,
Modified Photo Zoomer: color-based solutions now enlarge pieces instead of changing their color.,
Corrected the Experiment puzzle so players can no longer stack flasks on each other.,

UI Improvements:

Updated Channeling UI to display current action details.,
Journal based solution input now provides proper feedback on incorrect puzzle solutions.,
Added an inventory-full indicator.,
Added even more first-time examine indicators for new items.,
Replaced the "Solve it" Button with "Enter Code" button under journal based solution puzzles.,
Added an "Objectives Updated" indicator on the UI when a puzzle location was revealed on the Map.,

Bug Fixes & Stability:

Fixed several voice-chat issues.,
Multiple minor fixes and polish across UI and systems.
